children: Chinese regulators are unlikely to roll out stimulus, according to BofA Securities in a research note. August trade data suggests that the artificial-intelligence cycle remains the dominant driver of China's external sector, the bank says. "Barring a sharp deterioration in domestic activity, continued export strength, alongside the modest improvement in labor-intensive exports, may reduce policymakers' near-term urgency to introduce additional policy measures," the bank says. Investors will closely watch August economic activity data due next week for a clearer read on the strength of domestic demand. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
